logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Editable analytical figure for the WO-02 decision report. Left panel: vertical bar chart of measured energy per common HVAC duty test for candidates P4 (9), P3 (20), P2 (33) and P1 (50) kWh, plotted on a stated linear 0-55 kWh axis with gridlines at 10 kWh intervals and tick-checked bar tops, correcting the chart-scaling defect recorded in round 1; the recommended package P4 is annotated by a leader line rather than color spotlighting. Right panel: screening table listing quality (floor 80), raw defect count (ceiling 5), energy and verdict per candidate, all four qualifying. Footer states the common load, operating period and acceptance test basis and that unverified cost, delivery and maintenance fields are excluded from ranking. Static vector text and shapes only; no scripting, event handlers or external resources.
